title: Torsion algebras of Hermitian manifolds and rigidity
summary: We regard the Chern torsion of a Hermitian manifold as a skew-symmetric complex-bilinear product on its holomorphic tangent bundle. For a compact connected Chern--Kähler-like Hermitian manifold, we prove that this product satisfies the Jacobi identity pointwise. If, in addition, the Chern holomorphic sectional curvature is strongly quasi-positive, we show that the resulting torsion Lie algebra is nilpotent and must be abelian.
